question: ¿Cuántos ensayos clínicos de linfoma iniciados desde 2020 prueban rituximab?

attempts.query:
SELECT count(DISTINCT s.nct_id)
FROM aact.studies s
WHERE s.start_date >= DATE '2020-01-01'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aact.browse_conditions b WHERE b.nct_id = s.nct_id AND b.downcase_mesh_term = 'lymphoma')
  AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aact.interventions i WHERE i.nct_id = s.nct_id AND (i.name ILIKE '%rituximab%' OR i.name ILIKE '%rituxan%' OR i.name ILIKE '%mabthera%'))
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aact.intervention_other_names o WHERE o.nct_id = s.nct_id AND (o.name ILIKE '%rituximab%' OR o.name ILIKE '%rituxan%' OR o.name ILIKE '%mabthera%')))
